study type: Observational, cross-sectional, retrospective, descriptive, and comparative study
outcome: Thickness of RVS (upper, middle, and lower thirds)
cohort: 102 Hispanic women ≥15 years of age from northeast Mexico
finding: The morphology of the rectovaginal septum (RVS) is influenced by factors such as age, number of pregnancies, mode of delivery, and estrogenic exposure, suggesting these factors should be considered in preoperative management and surgical planning.
mod_finding: Women with mixed deliveries had increased RVS length and middle-third thickness compared to other delivery methods, while those with only cesarean sections had increased upper- and lower-third thickness.
